question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party and its military apparatus underpins the overwhelming trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent high-level purges of Politburo and Central Military Commission figures, including senior generals and civilian leaders, have reinforced perceptions of his dominance rather than exposed weakness, with no public signs of organized opposition or alternative power centers emerging ahead of the 21st Party Congress. At age 73, Xi faces no formal term limits or imminent succession pressure, and elite reshuffles continue to prioritize loyalty over generational change. While sudden health events, an unforeseen elite fracture, or acute economic instability could theoretically alter trajectories within the narrow remaining window, current structural controls and absence of visible challengers sustain the near-certain market pricing.
